description: This file defines an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache implementation by extending LinkedHashMap, providing a bounded cache with a maximum size and eviction policy.

classes.name: LRUMap
classes.description: A specialized LinkedHashMap that enforces a maximum size and evicts least recently used entries when the limit is exceeded.

methods.name: LRUMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing with default max size.

methods.name: setMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of entries before eviction occurs.

methods.name: removeEldestEntry
methods.description: Overridden method to determine when eldest entries should be removed based on max size.
